detections.evidence_quote: Twenty percent of muscle is branched-chain amino acids.
detections.summary: Guest explains that leucine, isoleucine and valine are essential branched-chain amino acids important for muscle, and that bodybuilders take protein powder for extra BCAAs when building muscle.

detections.evidence_quote: they end up making liver fat, and that liver fat ends up causing insulin resistance, also
detections.summary: Guest explains that in people not building muscle, excess branched-chain amino acids are processed in the liver and overwhelm the Krebs cycle, causing liver fat that leads to insulin resistance.

detections.evidence_quote: The liver deamidates them; it takes the amino group off
detections.summary: Guest uses biochemical mechanism vocabulary (deamidation, the Krebs cycle) to explain how excess amino acids are metabolized.

detections.evidence_quote: So take them after you exercise, basically.
detections.summary: Guest clarifies that branched-chain amino acids only aid muscle synthesis when paired with exercise, so should be taken after exercising.

detections.evidence_quote: corn-fed beef, chicken, or fish, because corn is very, very high in branched chain amino acids
detections.summary: Guest claims corn-fed meat is high in branched-chain amino acids because corn itself is high in them, while grass-fed or wild meat has a healthier amino acid profile.

detections.evidence_quote: shall we say, healthier amino acid, a healthier amino acid profile
detections.summary: Wild or regenerative meat is favored over corn-fed meat as having a healthier, more natural amino acid profile.

detections.evidence_quote: the Food and Drug Administration privatized that list
detections.summary: Speakers criticize that trans fats remain in the food supply despite a 2015 government safety ruling, and recount how the FDA's 1958 list of 170 safe food additives has grown to about 10,000 after being effectively delegated to food companies.

detections.evidence_quote: They basically farmed it out to the food companies to decide what should be on that list.
detections.summary: FDA is portrayed as having handed off food-safety determinations to the food industry itself.

detections.evidence_quote: any food company can put any damn thing they want and say it's okay, and that is just not true
detections.summary: Food companies are portrayed as able to declare any ingredient safe without real oversight.

detections.evidence_quote: The FDA really has become more. Of the FMA, the Federal Medicines Association, than they are the the Food and Drug Food and Drug Administration.
detections.summary: Speakers discuss fixing the food system through USDA, FDA and Congressional action, describing the food supply as toxic and the FDA as more focused on medicines than food.

detections.evidence_quote: we're living in a swamp. Of toxic foods that make us sick, that cause disease and kill us prematurely
detections.summary: Food supply is framed broadly as a toxic swamp making people sick.

detections.evidence_quote: The FDA really has become more. Of the FMA, the Federal Medicines Association, than they are the the Food and Drug Food and Drug Administration.
detections.summary: FDA is portrayed as having effectively become an agency for medicines rather than food safety.
